descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for an experienced, French-speaking Test Analyst to join our fast-growing team,
 responsible for testing applications and computer systems to ensure their quality, reliability,
 and compliance with business requirements. The team's mission is the maintenance
 of the operating conditions of the AppMobile applications and backend linked to the Digital
 Marketing business
 What you will do: 
 Perform functional and technical tests to identify defects and anomalies and ensure the quality of applications and systems
Define different testing strategies: manual, automated, API
Create and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts, maintain the test data
Implement non-regression tests
Ensure reporting and tracking of defects
Guarantee the quality of user stories and acceptance criteria
Collaborate with development and production teams to identify and resolve issues
Participate in writing test reports and test documents
Ensure compliance with testing standards and procedures
Participate in agile ceremonies and the development of user stories
Work closely with other testing team members to share knowledge and best practices
Contribute to cross-functional projects with impacts on its operating scope
 What you must have: 
Functional and technical testing
Knowledge of testing tools and programming/scripting languages
Fluent French
Functional knowledge of the consumer credits domain is a plus
Minimum of 4 years of experience in software testing
Previous experience as a tester on mobile applications (iOS and Android)
Device farm: Digital AI (mobiles, tablets...)
Knowledge of Agile testing methodologies
Experience with testing tools such as Octane, Jira, Postman/Bruno
Knowledge of programming languages such as Java
Knowledge of testing standards and procedures (ISTQB, etc.)
Ability to work in a team and communicate effectively and clearly
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
 ***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
